ambient: Your radius comes round to where it was.
Something at a larger radius takes longer and arrives anyway.
The whole assembly moves through a quarter and continues.
description: Something enormous is turning and you're one of the things fixed to it. Everything you can see is fixed to it too, at its own radius, going round at its own rate, and all of it's correct. There has been no moment at which this started.
name: The Wheel

looks: Turning. Not fast. It has never not been turning.
Its centre isn't visible and isn't far.
Everything is on it, at a radius, including the parts that look like ground.
objects.name: the wheel

looks: Sound. Whatever holds you on is holding.
You're at a radius that suits you and were put here.
It has been checked. There's a mark on it from the checking.
objects.name: your fixing

weather: A steady pull outward that has always been the direction of down.
